# Legamart

> A global cross-border legal services marketplace powered by AI lawyer matching, connecting legal professionals across 128+ countries for collaboration and client acquisition.

Legamart is a legal-tech platform that bridges international legal expertise by connecting immigration lawyers, IP attorneys, solo practitioners, in-house counsel, and legal experts across the UK, UAE, Europe, and beyond. The platform uses AI-powered matching (LegaBot) to facilitate seamless cross-border legal collaboration and case handling.

## Key Topics

- Cross-border legal services
- Lawyer marketplace
- AI lawyer matching
- Immigration law
- Intellectual property

- Arbitration

- UK and UAE focus

## Core Services & Practice Areas

- [Immigration Lawyer](https://legamart.com/immigration-lawyer): Immigration lawyer marketplace connecting professionals across UK, UAE, Europe
- [Intellectual Property](https://legamart.com/ip): IP attorney network for trademark, patent, copyright protection globally
- [Solo Practitioner](https://legamart.com/solo-practitioner): Solo practitioner network for cross-border case handling and client acquisition
- [In-House Counsels](https://legamart.com/in-house-counsel): In-house counsel legal outsourcing for compliance and cross-border expertise
- [Legal Expert](https://legamart.com/legal-expert): Legal expert marketplace for advisory, research, and case collaboration services
